anchor: Which fiery outsider can drop a flame barrier once per day and also cast a plane-hopping teleport, with spellcasting relying on presence and force of personality?
Which fire-natured monster can turn into a cloud of vapor and vanish from sight, once each per day, yet reads magic at will?
Which conjured floating fist can punch a foe for magical crushing harm, shove it around, or squeeze it, and also grant me cover?
What summoned grabbing appendage can seize a Huge-or-smaller foe that fails a roll to dodge, then crush it with a quick extra move on my turn?
What kit of dice, cards or chess-like boards lets me tell whether someone is cheating with a DC 10 insight check?
If I want to win a contest of wits over cards or dice at DC 20, which cheap portable kit should I buy?
Which winged demon from the Abyss can spray a poisonous cloud that makes creatures sick, but comes back to life elsewhere if slain outside its home plane?
Which winged fiend resists cold, fire, and lightning harm and ends a lingering sickness when someone empties a flask of blessed water on the victim?
Which loud blast can I aim at a spot 60 feet away to hurt everyone in a small sphere, and it damages unattended objects too?
Which second-level booming spell gives golems and constructs a harder time resisting it, and also harms unattended objects in its area?
At the top tier of a nature-caster's career, how do I turn spare shapeshifting uses into a spell slot, and how often can I do it?
Which late-game nature-based feature makes me age only one year per decade and lets me regain a shapeshift at initiative with none left?
Which rare box of art supplies lets me conjure a real doorway or sinkhole inside a 20-foot cube after ten minutes of concentrated work?
My rogue wants to fake a treasure hoard with a rare art kit; what is the cap on each conjured item's value and on the total?
When my chaotic magic stick rolls a 21 to 25 on its random effects, what happens and how long am I dazed?
Which large demon with two grabbing limbs can see through illusions and invisibility and casts spells using its intellect?
Which demon of challenge level 9 can squeeze a foe it has seized and also cast magic using its intellect?
Which reanimated corpse-soldier, weak to crushing blows, fires a bow and can't be poisoned?
Which reanimated dead warrior with 13 hit points understands Common but cannot speak it, and sees in the dark?
Which huge giant has 126 hit points, hurls boulders that can topple Large-or-smaller foes, and can swat away ranged hits?
My ally took an arrow; which giant can use a reaction to shrug off that hit and blast a creature within 60 feet with energy?
What status leaves me unable to move at all and gives attacks against anyone but my captor a disadvantage roll?
When a wrestler has seized me, how much can I move and what penalty applies to hitting anyone other than the one holding me?
If I ask the game master for a reality-bending request outside the usual options, what risks follow, and could it just fail or backfire?
If my top-tier spell request would unmake the whole multiverse, does it work, and what if it harms a deity?
What light footwear lets me scale walls and ceilings with both hands free, but fails on ice or oil?
Which magic footwear lets me move up walls at my ordinary walking pace, though it won't grip slick ice?
Which legendary rod for wizards and sorcerers holds fifty charges and can cancel an enemy's targeted spell with a reaction?
If a hostile caster targets only me, can my rod cancel the spell and soak up its power as charges, and what if it overflows?
At a high rogue level, how many enchanted trinkets can I bond with at once, and can a die showing six save my charges?
Can a thief cast from a parchment spell written for someone else, and what if the spell is high-level and the check fails?
At the top of a sorcerer's career, while my innate power is switched on, can I tweak spells several times each turn without spending sorcery points?
Which headgear lets me mentally talk to others within 30 feet and use mind-reading or mind-nudging spells once until morning?
Which uncommon headgear that needs bonding with me gives two mind spells, each castable only once until sunrise?
Which fourth-level spell stashes a trunk holding up to 12 cubic feet on another plane, recallable by touching a miniature copy?
After how many days does a hidden strongbox on another plane start carrying a daily chance of its hiding spell ending?
Which third-level dark spell lets me drain a foe's life with a melee strike to heal myself, and can be repeated for a minute?
Mid-fight, which third-level wizard spell lets me strike at close range with 3d6 life-draining harm and regain half that as health?
Which very rare enchanted melee weapon deals extra icy harm on hits, grants resistance to fire, and snuffs out nearby flames when drawn?
In freezing temperatures, what enchanted melee weapon shines bright light out to 10 feet and dim light for 10 more?
Which large fiend can pose as a medium or large biped and inflict a curse on a victim it can see, leaving them besotted and sickened?
Which fiend can bound up to 30 feet and once per day each casts a scrying spell and a geas, using force of personality?
As a holy warrior at level 9, how do I make several enemies within 60 feet cower in fear for a minute unless they take damage?
A holy knight is surrounded; what level 9 power limits terrified enemies to just one of moving, acting, or a quick extra move on their turn?
Which colossal evil wyrm breathes a 90-foot corrosive line, is immune to that harm, and can turn four failed rolls into successes each day?
What chaotic evil monster of gargantuan size, with 367 hit points, can sense things nearby without sight and breathe air and water?
Which fourth-level mind spell makes one visible creature within 30 feet treat me as a friend for an hour unless I or my allies harm it?
When my friends are already scrapping with a creature, does a fourth-level mind spell make its roll to resist easier, and does it later learn I manipulated it?
What ranged cantrip hurls a 1d8 blast of my chosen element at 120 feet and lets me add an extra die whenever the die shows an eight?
Which energy cantrip grows from one die to two, three, then four dice as my character reaches levels 5, 11 and 17?
At what fighter level can I strike three times instead of once when I take my main action of the turn?
Which small flame-born creature explodes in a 5-foot burst when slain and breathes a cone of fire after rolling a 6 on a die?
Which flying creature with only 18 hit points is immune to flame and poison but weak to frost?
Which very rare rod for wizards and druids protects me from icy harm and holds ten charges for spells like a freezing cone or fog?
After using my last charge on a magic rod of ice spells, what is the 1-in-20 chance it turns to water?
Which sea-dwelling beast with 22 hit points swims 30 feet and gets an edge on bites when its buddies flank a target?
What water-only beast bites for about 7 damage and understands no languages at all?
Which fourth-level ward can wrap a large or smaller creature in a bubble that nothing passes through and no damage can break?
How can someone trapped in a fourth-level protective bubble escape, and can an outsider break it without harming the captive?
What past life grants bonuses to nimbleness, toughness, and smarts, plus skills at sneaky hand tricks and quiet movement?
Which backstory's gear is two daggers, lockpicks, a crowbar, pouches, and travel clothes, or else 50 gold?
Which rare drink cures every magical disease and ends blindness, deafness, being frozen in place, and poisoning?
Which rare potion, full of red liquid with light bubbles inside, cleans out magical sicknesses and ends several conditions?
Which rare defensive gear that needs bonding gives me +2 armor against projectiles and lets me take a hit aimed at an ally within 5 feet?
If a bowman targets my friend next to me, can I step in and become the target instead using my reaction?
Which first-level cleric spell cleanses poison and spoilage from ordinary meals and beverages in a small area within 10 feet?
Can a holy warrior purge poison and rot from ordinary provisions by casting it as a ritual rather than in combat?
Which huge beast has 68 hit points and swings its tail twice per turn to knock smaller creatures flat?
What giant beast with a mace-like tail can knock a foe prone if the foe is Huge or smaller?
Which spell brings nearby loose junk to life so it batters enemies with blows, and can't be scared or frozen?
How far can a magical servant made of ordinary things perceive without eyes, and which languages does it grasp?
Which second-level spell lets me stab a foe's thoughts from 120 feet away, hurting it and tracking it on this plane?
If I've already rattled a sneaky enemy's thoughts from across a room, can it still duck out of sight or stay invisible from me?
Which martial class uses a d10 for hit points and gets proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throws?
Which class relies on either brute force or agility as its main score and picks two of nine skills?
At level 5 as a nature-based spellcaster, what happens when I run out of shapeshifts, and can I regain one by spending a spell slot each turn?
Can a nature-caster convert a shapeshift use into a first-level spell slot, and how often can it happen?
